body.purpose: Paragraphs and control labels; short lines only.

data.purpose: Every number that changes over time, in tabular figures so digits do not jitter.

components.css: .ds-card { background: #12151a; border: 1px solid #21262e; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; max-width: 480px; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #2e343f; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; } .ds-title { color: #e8edf4; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: #38bdf8; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-lamp { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #38bdf8; } .ds-rail { display: flex; gap: 6px; list-style: none; margin: 12px 0 8px; padding: 0; } .ds-rail .seg { height: 4px; flex: 1; border-radius: 9999px; background: #2e343f; } .ds-rail .seg.active { background: #38bdf8; animation: ds-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.55; } } .ds-figrow { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: #6a7382; font-size: 12px; } .ds-fig { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-track { height: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #0e1116; margin-top: 8px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: #38bdf8; }

narrative.overview:
The dashboard is the panel face of the machine doing the work: a media transfer rack. Graphite ground a half-step off pure black, panels separated by hairline seams instead of shadows, one step of elevation between ground, panel and raised control. It borrows the transfer bay’s calm, dense competence — an appliance that reports rather than performs.

Motion exists only where it carries meaning: a lit stage segment pulses while its stage emits progress and stops the moment it does not. Sky is reserved for exactly one meaning, colour never carries state alone, and every number that counts is tabular so digits do not dance.

The category default — a flat grey card list with one blue accent doing nothing in particular — is the anti-reference.
keyCharacteristics: Dark graphite ground with hairline-seam panels; zero drop shadows anywhere.
One accent (sky) that means only "happening right now" — running stages, selection, focus.
Tabular figures for every moving number (bytes, speed, ETA, percent, timestamps).
The stage rail — download → process → validate → commit — as the signature state readout on every job.
Destructive actions outlined, isolated by empty space, never filled.
Self-hosted everything: the dashboard needs no internet to look correct.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Sky appears only where something is live: a running stage, a selection, a focus, an in-flight row. Nothing decorative may borrow it.

rules.name: The No Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: State colour is always paired with a lamp dot or a word. A hue shift is never the only carrier of meaning.

rules.name: The Tabular Figure Rule
rules.body: Any number that updates over time renders with tabular figures (.fig). Digits in motion must not jitter.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Archivo for everything except raw user-entered URLs. A display face for headlines is a category-costume mistake.

rules.name: The Seam Rule
rules.body: A panel is bounded by a 1px hairline, its hover a brighter hairline — never a shadow. Elevation is one step deep and that step is a colour change.

dos: Do serve every asset self-hosted — fonts, favicon, icons. A CDN link breaks the product’s core promise (local-first) and its offline behaviour.
Do give every moving number .fig (tabular figures).
Do pair every state colour with a lamp or a word.
Do isolate destructive actions: outlined, alone at the end of a row, empty space around them.
Do disable motion entirely under prefers-reduced-motion — the parallax stops, pulses stop, spinner turns slow to a near-static ring.
Do keep interactive elements showing cursor: pointer — set globally on button, [role=button], a, select, label[for].
donts: Don’t use sky for anything resting, decorative or illustrative. It means "happening right now" or "this one, selected" — nothing else.
Don’t show a spinner where no request is in flight. A spinner is a claim about work; a stale table gets a stale signal (the amber rail), not a busy animation.
Don’t cast shadows or use backdrop-filter on scroll-tracked surfaces.
Don’t animate layout properties. Colour and opacity transitions at 150–300ms; transforms for the parallax layer only.
Don’t restyle state words by hand — toneFor() in jobState.ts is the single map.
